prompt: Silver chases a beach ball from the pool to the pier
title: Beach Ball Chase
irony: The ball Silver was sure was lost brings everyone together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Hot sun beats down on the outdoor pool as Silver holds his big striped beach ball.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Silver wants a calm pool game of catch while Jade climbs the diving board and Silver dodges deck cracks.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black laughs as Jade cannonballs off the board and the huge splash knocks the striped ball over the fence.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Silver, Jade and Black run at the fence as the striped ball bounces away past the slide.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: On the sand the ball rolls past the umbrella and bumps the sandcastle while Silver dodges boardwalk cracks behind Jade.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The ball bumps the lifeguard tower and rolls on as Black bets they cannot catch it.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Silver and Jade sprint down the sand after the rolling ball as Navy joins the chase.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: At golden hour the ball bounces down the docks and drifts off the pier end as Orange gathers the friends.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange decides no one jumps in after it and Black lends his fishing net for a team rescue.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Silver counts the waves while Jade reaches with the net and scoops the striped ball home.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Back on the pier at sunset the whole crowd plays catch and Silver feels his luck has changed.
